<div class="latest" data-label="Τελευταία δημοσίευση:"></div>

:::
:::

<script>
(function () {
  const AUTHOR_ID = 2860811; // your INSPIRE author id
  const latestEl = document.querySelector(".latest");
  if (!latestEl) return;

  const LABEL = latestEl.dataset.label || "Latest:";
  latestEl.innerHTML = `<strong>${LABEL}</strong> <span>Loading…</span>`;

  // Cache for 6 hours
  const CACHE_KEY = `inspire_latest_${AUTHOR_ID}_hep_cite_v1`;
  try {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY);
    if (cached) {
      const { ts, html } = JSON.parse(cached);
      if (Date.now() - ts < 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {
        latestEl.innerHTML = html;
        return;
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  const jget = (url) =>
    fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } }).then((r) => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
      return r.json();
    });

  // Prefer author-id query; if empty, try BAI/name
  const qById =
    "https://inspirehep.net/api/literature" +
    "?sort=mostrecent&size=1" +
    "&q=" + encodeURIComponent(`authors.control_number:${AUTHOR_ID}`) +
    "&fields=titles,authors.full_name,publication_info,earliest_date,dois,arxiv_eprints,primary_arxiv_category";

  const authorURL = `https://inspirehep.net/api/authors/${AUTHOR_ID}?fields=ids,name`;

  function buildCitation(hit) {
    const md = hit.metadata || {};
    const id = hit.id;
    const recordUrl = `https://inspirehep.net/literature/${id}`;

    // Authors (exact order as INSPIRE)
    const authors = (md.authors || [])
      .map(a => a.full_name)
      .filter(Boolean);
    const authorsText = authors.join("; ");

    // Title
    const title = md.titles?.[0]?.title || "Untitled";

    // Journal info (choose a journal entry if present)
    const pubs = Array.isArray(md.publication_info) ? md.publication_info : [];
    const j = pubs.find(p => p.journal_title) || pubs[0] || {};
    const journal = j.journal_title || "";
    const volume = j.journal_volume || "";
    const year = j.year || (md.earliest_date || "").slice(0,4) || "";
    const pages =
      (j.page_start && j.page_end && `${j.page_start}-${j.page_end}`) ||
      j.page_start || j.artid || "";

    let journalBlock = "";
    if (journal) {
      journalBlock = [journal, volume].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
      if (year) journalBlock += ` (${year})`;
      if (pages) journalBlock += ` ${pages}`;
    } else if (year) {
      journalBlock = `(${year})`;
    }

    // DOI / arXiv
    const doi = (md.dois && md.dois[0] && md.dois[0].value) ? md.dois[0].value : "";
    const arx = (md.arxiv_eprints && md.arxiv_eprints[0] && (md.arxiv_eprints[0].value || md.arxiv_eprints[0].eprint)) || "";
    const cat = (md.primary_arxiv_category && md.primary_arxiv_category.term) ||
                (md.arxiv_eprints && md.arxiv_eprints[0] && Array.isArray(md.arxiv_eprints[0].categories) && md.arxiv_eprints[0].categories[0]) || "";

    // Compose: Authors, “Title”, Journal Vol (Year) pages, doi:..., arXiv:... [cat]
    const parts = [];
    if (journalBlock) parts.push(journalBlock);
    if (doi) parts.push(`doi:${doi}`);
    if (arx) parts.push(`arXiv:${arx}${cat ? ` [${cat}]` : ""}`);

    const citationHTML =
      `<strong>${LABEL}</strong> ` +
      `${authorsText}, ` +
      `&ldquo;<a href="${recordUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${title}</a>&rdquo;` +
      (parts.length ? `, <span>${parts.join(", ")}</span>` : "");

    return citationHTML;
  }

  function renderFromData(data) {
    const hit = data?.hits?.hits?.[0];
    if (!hit) throw new Error("No results");
    const html = buildCitation(hit);
    latestEl.innerHTML = html;
    try { localStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ ts: Date.now(), html })); } catch {}
  }

  // Try control_number first; if empty, resolve BAI and retry with 'a <BAI>' or exact name
  jget(qById)
    .then(d => {
      if (d?.hits?.hits?.length) { renderFromData(d); return null; }
      return jget(authorURL);
    })
    .then(authorData => {
      if (!authorData) return null;
      const amd = authorData.metadata || {};
      const ids = Array.isArray(amd.ids) ? amd.ids : [];
      const bai =
        ids.find(x => (x.schema || x.source || "").toUpperCase() === "BAI")?.value ||
        ids.map(x => x.value).find(v => typeof v === "string" && /\.\d+$/.test(v));
      const exactName = amd.name?.value || "";

      const queries = [];
      if (bai) queries.push(`a ${bai}`);
      if (exactName) queries.push(`ea ${exactName}`);

      const tryNext = () => {
        const q = queries.shift();
        if (!q) throw new Error("No results for any query");
        const url =
          "https://inspirehep.net/api/literature" +
          "?sort=mostrecent&size=1" +
          "&q=" + encodeURIComponent(q) +
          "&fields=titles,authors.full_name,publication_info,earliest_date,dois,arxiv_eprints,primary_arxiv_category";
        return jget(url).then(d => {
          if (d?.hits?.hits?.length) { renderFromData(d); return null; }
          return tryNext();
        });
      };
      return tryNext();
    })
    .catch(() => {
      const authorUrl = `https://inspirehep.net/authors/${AUTHOR_ID}`;
      latestEl.innerHTML =
        `<strong>${LABEL}</strong> <a href="${authorUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">See my publications on INSPIRE</a>`;
    });
})();
</script>
